title: Ninja v3 Is Live — Where We Are and What Comes Next
summary: AL Object ID Ninja v3 backend and VS Code extension are now in production with over 1,300 automated tests. The post covers the transition to commercial billing starting January 1st, new pricing models (flat per-user/app and pay-per-use), and maintenance expectations for self-hosted deployments during the feature expansion phase.
key_points: Ninja v3 backend runs on new endpoints with the latest Node runtime and over 1,300 automated tests; the v3 VS Code extension is on the Marketplace
No usage counting or billing until January 1st; pricing moved from elastic to flat per user and per app, plus packaged tiers and pay-per-use
Early Bird customers keep their custom price while staying within their stated limits and can switch tiers at any time with the discount still applied
Self-hosted teams should update their backend right away and expect more frequent backend updates while new features land
features: AL Object ID Ninja backend v3
